basis: Post-build source/artifact capture. Not a pre-build manifest or cryptographic proof that this source produced the app. Root reports product-source freeze before this build; timestamps are supplementary only. Frontend dist is current on-disk output, not extracted embedded app bytes.
sourceScope: Git-enumerated tracked and non-ignored files in src/public/scripts/tests, desktop source/scripts/ui, root package/build/type/quality configuration, plus six changed frontend specs. Dependencies are identified by lockfiles; ignored toolchain/node_modules and app user data excluded.
